candidates.change_summary: Change the requirement amount from 10 ether to 1 ether, altering which calls pass the value check and thus when pastBlockTime and transfers occur.
Invert the time comparison to require block.timestamp be less than or equal to pastBlockTime, changing which calls proceed and update pastBlockTime.
Remove the update to pastBlockTime so the stored time no longer changes on successful calls, affecting subsequent accept/reject decisions.
Change the transfer condition to trigger when block.number % 15 != 0, altering when the contract pays out its balance.
Transfer only the msg.value back to sender instead of the entire contract balance, changing post-call balances and observable behavior.
